workedExample.notice: Look for details that repeat or work together. Then name the important message they share.
workedExample.think: Ms. Chen names water, shelter, and late-opening flowers, and the class later adds all three.
workedExample.prove: Those details point to one larger idea: the garden can welcome nighttime insects.
workedExample.answer: The class is making the garden more useful for helpers that visit after dark.

passage.text: On Monday, Anaya carried a clipboard to the garden behind the library.
During the day, tomato flowers buzzed with bees, but at dusk the space became still.
Ms. Chen asked the class to imagine who might need the garden after the sun went down.
She explained that moths and beetles also help some plants, yet they need water, shelter, and flowers that open late.
The class found bare soil, a cracked birdbath, and only one narrow strip of blooms.
Instead of planning a huge makeover, each group chose one small change.
Anaya's group set out a shallow water dish filled with stones so tiny insects could climb out.
Another group stacked fallen branches near a wall to make a dry hiding place.
Two students planted white flowers because they would be easier to spot in dim light.
By Friday evening, the garden was not crowded or noisy.
Still, Anaya saw moths visiting the new flowers and beetles moving beneath the branches.
She wrote in her notebook, ‘A garden does not need to be loud to be useful. It needs to welcome more kinds of helpers.’
The class decided to check the garden once a week and record what they noticed.

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the passage's main idea?

choices.text: Small changes can make a school garden welcoming to nighttime helpers.
Tomato flowers are the only plants that insects visit after dark.
A noisy garden is more useful than a quiet garden.
The class should replace every part of the garden at once.

questions.explanation: The passage describes several small additions, then Anaya explains that a useful garden welcomes more kinds of helpers. That message connects the details in the whole passage.
